$comment: Assignment map for redesign-blog-covers: 22 posts -> 11 library pieces.
Keyed by the OLD cover media id, which is also the content/media/image-audit.json
entry key — so the repoint script can assert the post's current cover before writing,
and the audit supersession record has a stable anchor.
`library[*].mediaId` is filled by the upload step (task 4.1); it is null until then.
Briefs, reference assets and generation settings live in cover-library-brief.md.
New posts have no old cover id; their assignment keys are 'new-<slug>'.
